notes.title: Raptor Boyfriend 2.0!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Thanks for letting us know about some glitches, namely for the achievement "Played the Field". We have fixed this along with some other things:

- An image glitch with Stella's composite showing the wrong size in episode 3, scene 8.
- Updated the credits to reflect Sloane's proper name

As for getting this achievement, we won't tell you how, but it has to do with amount of times you call each character and the amount of times you choose to spend time with each one.  :)

Also another update - Raptor Boyfriend will be coming to consoles [b]December 14th![/b] 
This will include PS4/5, Xbox series x/One, and Nintendo Switch. So now you can experience Stella's last year of high school from the comfort of your couch!

notes.title: AttributeError: 'TransformState' object has no attribute 'size' Issues
notes.content:
We are receiving reports from certain players in the last few days regarding a bug with a traceback text as  follows:

I'm sorry, but an uncaught exception occurred.

While running game code:
AttributeError: 'TransformState' object has no attribute 'size'

This is due to the rollback on the build we had to do a few days prior. Essentially your old save file has  stored a variable that no longer exists in the current build. We are looking in to eradicating this issue but for now, rolling back or clicking "ignore" in the bottom corner of this exception screen should momentarily resolve it. If any of you want a more thorough fix, we'd be happy to walk you through it, but the process may require you to lose your save files.  If you are experiencing this issue please stay tuned for our updates!

Thanks so much for your patience,

- Rocket Adrift

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update: Problems with PC version and rendering
notes.content:
It was brought to our attention that some pc users with NVIDIA graphics cards may be experiencing graphical/rendering errors with the game. We corrected the issue for now by rolling back on the latest version of our engine that still had support for certain GPU accelerators on the PC build. Hopefully, there will be no future issues with rendering and/or graphical bugs. If there are, please let us know here on our Steam updates page! Thanks for your support,

- Pat, Titus & Lindsay

Thanks so much for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.1 update: addition of history log and removal of "no wait" functions
notes.content:
Hey, all! 

It was brought to our attention  that there were accessibility issues regarding reading the dialogue history in case a player skips ahead by accident, as well as the "no wait" function disrupting player's reading experience. We've added the  history log into the quick menu (in the top right-hand corner) so any dialogue missed can be read there. Also there should be no automatic skipping in the dialogue anymore. 

Thanks for your support and feel free to log any bugs here in the Steam community!

- Pat, Titus & Lindsay
